moments.selftext: Thank you, Prime Minister @JJansaSDS , for your friendship and steadfast support for Israel. 🇮🇱🇸🇮 It was great meeting with you at the UN. Israel and Slovenia are opening a new chapter in our relations, strengthening cooperation in technology, tourism, AI, security, research and investment. Together, we will turn our strong friendship into concrete opportunities for both our peoples. I look forward to seeing you soon in Jerusalem. Thank you, Prime Minister @JJansaSDS

moments.selftext: "Israel seems to be paying for an AI-generated website, to influence AI chatbots to provide pro-Israel answers that can then be cited by sources that rely on AI chatbots: an AI centipede of pro-Israel propaganda, if you will." "Foreign agent filings show that as part of a $1 million effort, the Israeli government has propped up the website “IsraelFact .com.” The site is the latest in a constellation of propaganda and influence campaigns that have cropped up in recent months." - via @Zeteo
